275360259.description:
Sheaffer
Lady Sheaffer Fountain Pen - Gold-Tone Brushed Finish
Vintage (Circa 1958-1960s), 1 Pen with Case
This Lady Sheaffer fountain pen represents the intersection of mid-century fashion and high-quality craftsmanship from one of America's most prestigious pen manufacturers. Part of the "Skripsert" line launched in the late 1950s, these pens were designed specifically as stylish accessories for women, often featuring clip-less designs or refined jewelry-like finishes. This specific example features a sophisticated brushed gold-tone finish complemented by an intricate, ornate engraved band on the cap, showcasing the brand's commitment to both utility and style during the peak of fountain pen production.
"Lady Sheaffer" branding clearly visible on the interior lid of the original case
Distinctive brushed metal body with an ornate floral scroll engraved band on the cap
Includes original blue textured hard shell case with satin-lined interior
Accompanied by the internal metal cartridge sleeve/converter housing
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The brushed metal finish shows light age-appropriate surface wear and minor tarnish consistent with use. The ornate cap band remains well-defined. The nib is present and appears straight, though the pen is currently untested for ink flow. The original case shows light exterior wear and storage dust; the hinge functions correctly and the interior lining is intact.
